description: This file defines a custom WebApplicationFactory for integration testing, configuring an in-memory database environment for the Public API endpoints in the eShopOnWeb project. It sets up test-specific service configurations and overrides the host creation process.

classes.name: TestApiApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for functional testing of the Public API, configured with in-memory databases and environment settings.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set up the test environment, replace services with in-memory databases, and configure the host for testing.
